exposure: Type of maternal anesthesia during Cesarean section (general anesthesia vs. spinal anesthesia)
Type of maternal anesthesia during cesarean section
cohort: 760 neonates born by Cesarean section at the Medical University of Graz (Austria) from November 2009 to September 2016
finding: Cerebral tissue oxygenation in neonates during immediate transition after birth was similar after maternal general and spinal anesthesia during Cesarean section.
gest_age: Term (38.8 ± 0.9 weeks of gestation) and preterm (32.0 ± 2.9 weeks of gestation)
